mapper.select: SELECT id, course_id, title, description, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.exam_matrices WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, course_id, title, description, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.exam_matrices WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT id, course_id, title, description, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.exam_matrices WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND id = #{id} AND lifecycle_status = 'DRAFT' FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.id, m.course_id AS courseId, m.title, m.description, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS rowCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_outcomes row_mapping JOIN edu.custom_learning_level_learning_outcomes level_mapping ON level_mapping.learning_outcome_id = row_mapping.learning_outcome_id AND level_mapping.custom_learning_level_id = c.custom_learning_level_id AND level_mapping.is_selected = TRUE WHERE row_mapping.exam_matrix_row_id = r.id AND row_mapping.is_selected = TRUE ) THEN c.question_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalQuestionCount, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu.custom_learning_levels level WHERE level.matrix_id = m.id) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu.custom_learning_levels level WHERE level.matrix_id = m.id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu.custom_learning_level_learning_outcomes mapping WHERE mapping.custom_learning_level_id = level.id AND mapping.is_selected = TRUE ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu.learning_outcomes outcome WHERE outcome.course_id = m.course_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu.custom_learning_levels level JOIN edu.custom_learning_level_learning_outcomes mapping ON mapping.custom_learning_level_id = level.id AND mapping.learning_outcome_id = outcome.id AND mapping.is_selected = TRUE WHERE level.matrix_id = m.id ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu.exam_matrix_rows matrix_row WHERE matrix_row.matrix_id = m.id AND ( matrix_row.chapter_id IS NULL OR matrix_row.topic IS NULL OR btrim(matrix_row.topic) = '' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_outcomes mapping WHERE mapping.exam_matrix_row_id = matrix_row.id AND mapping.is_selected = TRUE ) ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_level_counts matrix_count JOIN edu.exam_matrix_rows matrix_row ON matrix_row.id = matrix_count.exam_matrix_row_id WHERE matrix_row.matrix_id = m.id AND matrix_count.question_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'MULTIPLE_CHOICE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_outcomes row_mapping JOIN edu.custom_learning_level_learning_outcomes level_mapping ON level_mapping.learning_outcome_id = row_mapping.learning_outcome_id AND level_mapping.custom_learning_level_id = matrix_count.custom_learning_level_id AND level_mapping.is_selected = TRUE WHERE row_mapping.exam_matrix_row_id = matrix_count.exam_matrix_row_id AND row_mapping.is_selected = TRUE ) ) THEN 'COMPLETE' ELSE 'INCOMPLETE' END AS configurationStatus, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM edu.exam_matrices m LEFT JOIN edu.exam_matrix_rows r ON r.matrix_id = m.id LEFT JOIN edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_level_counts c ON c.exam_matrix_row_id = r.id WHERE m.course_id = #{courseId} GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY m.created_at ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT outcome.id FROM edu.exam_matrices matrix JOIN edu.learning_outcomes outcome ON outcome.course_id = matrix.course_id WHERE matrix.id = #{matrixId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu.custom_learning_levels level JOIN edu.custom_learning_level_learning_outcomes mapping ON mapping.custom_learning_level_id = level.id AND mapping.learning_outcome_id = outcome.id AND mapping.is_selected = TRUE WHERE level.matrix_id = matrix.id ) ORDER BY outcome.id

SELECT o.exam_matrix_row_id AS examMatrixRowId, o.learning_outcome_id AS learningOutcomeId, o.is_selected AS selected FROM edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_outcomes o JOIN edu.exam_matrix_rows r ON r.id = o.exam_matrix_row_id WHERE r.matrix_id = #{matrixId} ORDER BY o.exam_matrix_row_id, o.learning_outcome_id

SELECT c.exam_matrix_row_id AS examMatrixRowId, c.custom_learning_level_id AS customLearningLevelId, l.code, l.name, l.description, l.sort_order AS sortOrder, c.question_type AS questionType, c.question_count AS questionCount FROM edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_level_counts c JOIN edu.custom_learning_levels l ON l.id = c.custom_learning_level_id JOIN edu.exam_matrix_rows r ON r.id = c.exam_matrix_row_id WHERE r.matrix_id = #{matrixId} ORDER BY c.exam_matrix_row_id, l.sort_order, l.id

SELECT count_record.exam_matrix_row_id AS examMatrixRowId, count_record.custom_learning_level_id AS customLearningLevelId, mapping.learning_outcome_id AS learningOutcomeId FROM edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_level_counts count_record JOIN edu.exam_matrix_rows matrix_row ON matrix_row.id = count_record.exam_matrix_row_id JOIN edu.custom_learning_level_learning_outcomes mapping ON mapping.custom_learning_level_id = count_record.custom_learning_level_id AND mapping.is_selected = TRUE JOIN edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_outcomes row_outcome ON row_outcome.exam_matrix_row_id = count_record.exam_matrix_row_id AND row_outcome.learning_outcome_id = mapping.learning_outcome_id AND row_outcome.is_selected = TRUE WHERE matrix_row.matrix_id = #{matrixId} ORDER BY count_record.exam_matrix_row_id, count_record.custom_learning_level_id, mapping.learning_outcome_id
SELECT id, matrix_id AS matrixId, code, name, description, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM edu.custom_learning_levels WHERE id IN #{id}

SELECT id, matrix_id AS matrixId, code, name, description, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM edu.custom_learning_levels WHERE matrix_id = #{matrixId} ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT custom_learning_level_id AS customLearningLevelId, learning_outcome_id AS learningOutcomeId, is_selected AS selected FROM edu.custom_learning_level_learning_outcomes WHERE custom_learning_level_id IN #{id} ORDER BY custom_learning_level_id, learning_outcome_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.exam_matrices (id, course_id, title, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{courseId}, #{title}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
INSERT INTO edu.exam_matrix_rows (id, matrix_id, chapter_id, topic, order_index) VALUES (#{id}, #{matrixId}, #{chapterId}, #{topic}, #{orderIndex})

INSERT INTO edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_outcomes (exam_matrix_row_id, learning_outcome_id, is_selected) SELECT matrix_row.id, chapter_outcome.learning_outcome_id, FALSE FROM edu.exam_matrix_rows matrix_row JOIN edu.chapter_learning_outcomes chapter_outcome ON chapter_outcome.chapter_id = matrix_row.chapter_id WHERE matrix_row.id = #{rowId} ON CONFLICT (exam_matrix_row_id, learning_outcome_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_level_counts (exam_matrix_row_id, custom_learning_level_id, matrix_id, question_type, question_count) SELECT #{rowId}, #{count.customLearningLevelId}, matrix_id, #{count.questionType, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.course.app.domain.ExamMatrixQuestionType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{count.questionCount} FROM edu.exam_matrix_rows WHERE id = #{rowId} ON CONFLICT (exam_matrix_row_id, custom_learning_level_id) DO UPDATE SET question_type = EXCLUDED.question_type, question_count = EXCLUDED.question_count
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.exam_matrices SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND lifecycle_status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE edu.exam_matrices SET version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND lifecycle_status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM edu.exam_matrix_rows WHERE matrix_id = #{matrixId} AND id = #{rowId}
